_comment: AMP owns these server.properties keys and rewrites the file on every start, so they are applied as AMP settings (server/amp_api.py settings ...) instead of a server.properties template. Applied on the first sync only; re-apply with sync-server.sh --reapply-settings. SleepMode must stay False: AMP sleep stops the whole server when nobody is online, which would halt FTB Chunks force-loaded factories.
